note: Score each expected_behavior line independently. These are authored evaluations, not executed results.

scenarios.title: Resumable orchestrator
scenarios.query: Design a production orchestrator for research tasks with parallel collection, one checker, a human approval before publication, and resume after restart.
expected_behavior: Represents work as a graph whose edges name payloads
Places a convergence checker before the consuming node
Persists enough state to resume without replaying completed side effects
Names provider failure and context-pressure behavior

scenarios.title: Evaluation suite
scenarios.query: Create an eval plan for a support agent that uses search and refund tools. We care about regressions in tool choice, not only polished answers.
expected_behavior: Separates outcome, trajectory and tool-contract checks
Includes production-derived regression fixtures and adversarial cases
Defines judge calibration before trusting model grades
Records model, prompt and tool versions with results

scenarios.title: Protocol boundary
scenarios.query: Audit an agent that exposes MCP tools, talks to another agent over A2A, and has a 900-line system prompt.
expected_behavior: Separates MCP tool interoperability from A2A agent interoperability
Pins protocol claims to a named specification revision
Audits prompt and tool descriptions at the harness layer
Does not route repository coordination to the agent-system layer
